name: Animate Element
body:
School transmutation (see text); Level druid 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, F (a fetish attuned to elementals)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target instrument touched
Duration 1 round/level (D) or see text

DESCRIPTION

Speaking to nature you coalesce a helpful elemental.

When you cast this spell you must touch the element you wish to animate. You may animate air, earth, fire, or water with this spell. Animating the element in question grants you control over a small elemental of that type. At 5th caster level you may use this spell to animate a medium elemental, at 9th caster level you may animate a large elemental and at 13th caster level you may animate a huge elemental. You must be able to touch a source of the element you wish to animate of the equivalent size. The elemental can be directed as a move action on your turn. When not given orders it will defend you and attack enemies that threaten you or your allies.

You may instead cast this spell as a ritual which takes 10 minutes and 500 gp in supplies. If you do, its duration becomes 1 day per caster level. You may only have one such casting of animate element active at a time.

This spell gains the descriptor associated with the element animated.
